title: Prepositions that matter
intro: Small words, big impression. Wrong prepositions are the second thing a listener notices. Learn the patterns for time, place and the most common business verbs.
introBn: ছোট শব্দ, কিন্তু ভুল হলে সবার আগে চোখে পড়ে।

units.title: Time: at, on, in, by, until
units.idea: at for a clock time, on for a day or date, in for longer periods. By = not later than; until = up to that time.
units.ideaBn: at = ঘড়ির সময়, on = দিন/তারিখ, in = মাস/বছর/সময়কাল। by = এর মধ্যে, until = পর্যন্ত।

formula.name: Points
formula.pos: at 9 am · at noon · at night · at the weekend (UK)

formula.name: Days
formula.pos: on Monday · on 5 May · on my birthday

formula.name: Periods
formula.pos: in June · in 2026 · in the morning · in two days (from now)

uses.rule: No preposition before this, next, last, every, tomorrow, yesterday.
uses.ex: See you next Monday. (not: on next Monday)

uses.rule: By = deadline; until = continuous up to then.
uses.ex: Send it by Friday. I'll be in the office until 6.

uses.rule: In + time = after that time from now.
uses.ex: The driver will be here in ten minutes.
I slept during the flight. I slept for two hours.

traps.bn: last/next এর আগে কিছু বসে না।

drills.s: The interview is ___ Tuesday.
Let's start ___ 10:30 sharp.
Please send the report ___ Thursday.
The shop stays open ___ midnight.
Your food will arrive ___ 20 minutes.

o: I'll call you on next week.
I'll call you in next week.
I'll call you at next week.
I slept in during the flight.

drills.s: The office will be closed ___ the morning of 16 December.
drills.x: A specific morning (with a date) takes on.

drills.q: A start date in a job offer.
drills.s: You will start work ___ the beginning of next month.
drills.x: At the beginning / at the end of.

units.title: Place: at, in, on, to
units.idea: at a point (at the gate, at the bank), in an area or inside (in Dhaka, in the room), on a surface or line (on the table, on the road). To shows movement.
units.ideaBn: at = নির্দিষ্ট জায়গা, in = ভেতরে/এলাকায়, on = উপরে/তলের ওপর, to = কোথাও যাওয়া।

formula.name: Point
formula.pos: at the station · at work · at home · at the meeting

formula.name: Inside
formula.pos: in the car · in a taxi · in Gulshan · in the photo

formula.name: Surface / transport
formula.pos: on the bus · on the train · on a plane · on the 5th floor

uses.rule: Car and taxi: in. Bus, train, plane, rickshaw: on.
uses.ex: I'm in a taxi. I'm on the bus.

uses.rule: Arrive in a city/country, arrive at a building/point. Never 'arrive to'.
uses.ex: We arrived in Dhaka. We arrived at the airport.

uses.rule: Go to, but go home (no to).

uses.ex: Our office is on the 7th floor.

traps.wrong: I reached to Dhaka at night.
traps.right: I reached Dhaka at night. / I arrived in Dhaka at night.

drills.s: I'm stuck ___ traffic. I'll be late.
The meeting room is ___ the fourth floor.
We arrived ___ Chattogram at 7 am.
Call me when you arrive ___ the hotel.

o: She reached to the office late.
She reached at the office late.
She reached in the office late.

drills.s: She is ___ a meeting right now.
He walked ___ the room without knocking.

units.title: Verb + preposition (business)
units.idea: Many verbs have a fixed partner, and some have none. Learn them as one unit: depend on, reply to, discuss (nothing), explain to.
units.ideaBn: কিছু verb এর সাথে নির্দিষ্ট preposition বসে, আর কিছুর সাথে কিছুই বসে না — বাংলা অনুবাদ করে 'about' বসাবেন না।

formula.name: No preposition
formula.pos: discuss it · contact us · attend the meeting · answer the email · enter the room · reach the office

formula.name: Fixed partners
formula.pos: reply to · depend on · apply for · insist on · agree with (a person) / to (a plan) · explain it to me

uses.rule: Discuss, contact, attend, answer, enter, reach, marry: no preposition.
uses.ex: Let's discuss the budget. Please contact HR.

uses.rule: Reply to, listen to, explain to, belong to.
Responsible for, apply for, wait for, pay for.
uses.ex: I'm responsible for the sales team.

uses.rule: Interested in, good at, afraid of, aware of, similar to, different from.

drills.s: Let's ___ the new pricing tomorrow.
Thanks for your quick reply ___ my question.
I'd like to apply ___ the position of Sales Executive.
drills.x: Apply for a job (apply to a company).

o: Can you explain me how it works?
Can you explain how it works to me?
Can you explain to me how does it work?
Can you explain me about how it works?
drills.a: Can you explain how it works to me?
drills.x: Explain + thing + to + person (explain to me how it works is also fine).

drills.s: Our plan depends ___ the budget.
Please contact ___ our support team.
The board agreed ___ the proposal.
drills.x: Agree to a plan; agree with a person.

drills.s: Our approach is quite different ___ theirs.

o: He insisted to pay the bill.
He insisted on paying the bill.
He insisted for paying the bill.
He insisted paying on the bill.
drills.a: He insisted on paying the bill.

mastery.s: I look forward ___ hearing from you.
I'll call you back ___ five minutes.

o: We will discuss about it on next meeting.
We will discuss it at the next meeting.
We will discuss it in next meeting.
We will discuss about it at next meeting.
mastery.a: We will discuss it at the next meeting.
mastery.x: Discuss + object; at a meeting; the next.

mastery.q: আমি পাঁচ বছর ধরে এই কোম্পানিতে আছি।
o: I have been with this company for five years.
I am in this company since five years.
I have been in this company from five years.
I am with this company for five years.
mastery.a: I have been with this company for five years.

mastery.s: What time did you get ___ the office?
The payment must be made ___ the 25th.
She's very good ___ handling difficult clients.
